notes.title: Patch v0.69.3
notes.notes: [p]Hello fans! Thank you so much for the continuous support![/p][p][/p][p]We received more feedback from you guys, so we immediately started working on them.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Stella Magical Idol v0.69.3[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Minor fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented the windowed fullscreen to be set as the window mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem with the second sex scene where the SFX and moaning would stop.[/p][/*][/list][p]QOL changes[/p][list][*][p]Changed the default volume for the sex SFX and the moanings from 10 to 50.[/p][/*][*][p]The reset save file button on the settings (when accessed from the main menu) now doesn't reset the story mode tutorials flags.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed hints to solutions and reworked the scene solutions's text, it now describes clearly what you need to do to solve the puzzle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]TYSM for all the support ❤️❤️❤️ it means the world to us. We hope to keep reading more of your feedback, and thank you a lot for taking the time to fill the survey![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the stage or maybe being attacked by a big bad Kaiju.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.69.2
notes.notes: [p]Hello fans! Thank you so much for the continuous support![/p][p][/p][p]We received more reports of bugs and some QOL feedback, so we immediately worked on them.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Stella Magical Idol v0.69.2[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Minor fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you skipped dialogue so fast on the dating app minigame dialogue that it would cause an empty white placeholder and empty text, this would prevent the sex scene to appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would sometimes change when entering the dating app mini game.[/p][/*][/list][p]QOL changes[/p][list][*][p]Left click and space bar now both makes all the dialogue appear and makes the next dialogue to start (previously you needed to left click to make all the dialogue appear and use space bar to go to the next dialogue).[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu tutorial dialogues reduced from 8 lines to 5.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]TYSM for all the support it means the world to us. We hope to keep reading more of your feedback, see you on the stage or maybe being attacked by a big bad Kaiju.[/p]
